dct_description_sm:
DOTS (Data on Terrorist Suspects) provides textual biographic information on every terrorist covered by the chronology to cover all terrorists, supporters and other individuals mentioned in ITERATE.

PLEASE NOTE: Even if the dataset you are reviewing is labeled one year, it may contain information for the following year (eg. DOTS 2014 containing 2015 data).
